djiSteps.title: Open DJI Mimo
djiSteps.desc: Launch DJI Mimo and connect your DJI camera.

djiSteps.title: "Live" tab
djiSteps.desc: In Mimo, tap the Live icon at the bottom of the screen.

djiSteps.title: Paste the full URL
djiSteps.desc: Copy the full URL above (URL + key concatenated) and paste it in Mimo.

djiSteps.title: Check audio
djiSteps.desc: In Mimo settings, confirm the sound comes from the external mic input.

djiSteps.title: Start
djiSteps.desc: Tap "Start" in Mimo. Your SHUT live is running!

larixSteps.title: Install Larix Broadcaster
larixSteps.desc: Download Larix Broadcaster from the App Store (free).

larixSteps.title: Create a connection
larixSteps.desc: In Larix: Settings → Connections → + to add a connection.

larixSteps.title: Paste the RTMP URL
larixSteps.desc: URL: paste the SHUT RTMP URL. Stream name: paste your stream key separately.

larixSteps.title: Configure audio
larixSteps.desc: In Larix, select the jack input as audio source.

larixSteps.title: Select camera
larixSteps.desc: Choose front or rear camera in the Larix interface.

larixSteps.title: Start the live
larixSteps.desc: Tap the red button in Larix. Your SHUT live is running!

goproSteps.title: GoPro Labs installed?
goproSteps.desc: Make sure you have installed the GoPro Labs firmware (gopro.com/labs) on your camera.

goproSteps.title: Copy the full URL
goproSteps.desc: Copy the full SHUT URL (URL + key concatenated) above.

goproSteps.title: Generate the QR code
goproSteps.desc: In the GoPro Quik app → Labs QR tab → create an "RTMP" QR code and paste your URL.

goproSteps.title: Scan with the GoPro
goproSteps.desc: On the GoPro: hold the Mode button → select "Scan QR" → scan the QR code.

goproSteps.title: Start
goproSteps.desc: Start the live from the GoPro. It streams directly to SHUT!
